summary: The strip has one real problem: the camera and pose jump between 53.76 and 53.80, and the pink prop he held at his collar disappears.

faults.what: Between 53.76 and 53.80 the camera angle and background jump (gifts, gold post and balloon all shift sharply). His arms also snap from the collar pose to a chest-level pose. 53.66 to 53.76 are almost identical, so this reads as a late cut or a tween, not a smooth orbit start.
faults.fix: Put the cut on 53.73, the first frame of the shot, and start the orbit from that framing. Or ease the camera over several frames instead of one jump.

faults.what: The pink item he holds at his collar in 53.66 to 53.76 is gone at 53.80 and after. It looks like a prop vanishing, with no hand release.
faults.fix: Hide the prop on the cut frame or animate a visible release. Keep it in the hand if it is meant to stay.
